measure.description: If specified, only this measure is checked.

direction.description: Which direction of change should be detected.

minChange.description: Minimum trend/change fraction to be detected.

maxAgeDays.description:
Only measures with data points within the last _n_ days are considered. Note that older data points will be used
(depending on #maxValues) if there are _any_ points within this range.

maxValues.description:
The maximum number of most recent values to consider per measure. This limits the total amount of data points,
but this corresponds to a varying amount of time depending on how many measures are recorded per day which match
the overall queries.

limit.description: Maximum number of metrics to return.

aggregateBy.description:
Aggregation statistic used for measurement values. The default is the simple average, but other descriptive
statistics are also possible:
 - `avg` arithmetic mean (simple average)
 - `min` minimum value
 - `max` maximum value
 - `variance` the average of the squares of the differences from the mean
 - `median` point that half the values are above and half below
 - `Q1` point that only ¼ of the values are below (first quartile)
 - `Q3` point that only ¼ of the values are above (third quartile)
 - `D1` point that only ⅒ of the values are below (first decile)
 - `D9` point that only ⅒ of the values are above (ninth decile)

styles.description: Include a basic style sheet for formatting the table.

intro.description: Include an introductory paragraph before the table.

rootClass.description: CSS class to associate with intro paragraph and table.

introId.description: If specified, the introductory paragraph with be generated with the specified id attribute.

tableId.description: If specified, the trend table with be generated with the specified id attribute.

completeHtml.description: If true, generate a full HTML document, not just a `<div>`.

sparklines.description:
Whether and how sparklines are included in the table.
 - `embedded` SVG charts inline
 - `datauri` SVG charts encoded as a URI
 - `text` single line of text characters
 - `none` sparkline column is omitted
